template: I'm ... / My name's ...
func_zh: 自我介绍，说出自己的名字
grammar_point: be 动词 + 名字；I'm = I am
explanation_zh: 介绍自己用 I'm + 名字，更正式可以说 My name's ...（name's = name is）。

examples.en: Hi, I'm Tom. Nice to meet you!
examples.zh: 嗨，我是汤姆。很高兴认识你！

examples.en: My name's Gina.
examples.zh: 我叫吉娜。

template: This is ...
grammar_point: 指示代词 this + is
explanation_zh: 介绍距离近的人用 This is ...，回答常用 Nice to meet you.

examples.en: Mom, this is my new friend, Lily.
examples.zh: 妈妈，这是我的新朋友莉莉。

examples.en: This is my sister. She is nine.
examples.zh: 这是我妹妹，她九岁。

template: What's this/that in English?
func_zh: 询问某物用英语怎么说
grammar_point: what 引导的特殊疑问句
explanation_zh: 近处用 this，远处用 that；回答用 It's a/an ...

examples.en: What's this in English? — It's a ruler.
examples.zh: 这个用英语怎么说？——它是尺子。

examples.en: What's that over there? — It's an orange.
examples.zh: 那边那个是什么？——是橙子。

template: What color is it? — It's red.
grammar_point: what color 特殊疑问句
explanation_zh: 颜色词直接跟在 It's 后面；元音开头的颜色前不加冠词。

examples.en: What color is your pen? — It's blue.
examples.zh: 你的钢笔是什么颜色？——蓝色。

examples.en: The cup is black and white.
examples.zh: 这个杯子是黑白相间的。

template: Who is/are ...? — She's/He's/They're ...
grammar_point: who 疑问句；人称代词 he/she/they
explanation_zh: 问“是谁”用 who；单数用 is，复数用 are。

examples.en: Who is she? — She's my English teacher.
examples.zh: 她是谁？——她是我的英语老师。

examples.en: Who are they? — They're my grandparents.
examples.zh: 他们是谁？——是我的祖父母。

template: Is this/that your ...? — Yes, it is. / No, it isn't.
grammar_point: be 动词一般疑问句及简略回答
explanation_zh: 把 is 提到句首构成疑问句；简略回答用 it 代替物品。

examples.en: Is this your pencil? — Yes, it is. Thank you!
examples.zh: 这是你的铅笔吗？——是的，谢谢！

examples.en: Is that her schoolbag? — No, it isn't.
examples.zh: 那是她的书包吗？——不，不是。

template: Where is/are ...? — It's/They're in/on/under ...
grammar_point: where 疑问句；方位介词 in/on/under
explanation_zh: in 在里面，on 在上面，under 在下面；复数用 are/they're。

examples.en: Where is my eraser? — It's in your pencil box.
examples.zh: 我的橡皮在哪？——在你铅笔盒里。

examples.en: Where are my books? — They're on the desk.
examples.zh: 我的书在哪？——在书桌上。

template: Do you have ...? — Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
func_zh: 询问对方是否拥有某物
grammar_point: 实义动词一般现在时疑问句借助 do
explanation_zh: have 是实义动词，提问和否定要借助助动词 do/does。

examples.en: Do you have a soccer ball? — Yes, I do.
examples.zh: 你有足球吗？——有。

examples.en: Do they have a basketball? — No, they don't.
examples.zh: 他们有篮球吗？——没有。

template: Let's ...!
func_zh: 发出邀请或提议一起做某事
grammar_point: let's = let us + 动词原形
explanation_zh: Let's 后面一定接动词原形；回答可用 Good idea! / Sounds good!

examples.en: Let's play basketball after school!
examples.zh: 放学后我们去打篮球吧！

examples.en: Let's ask the teacher for help.
examples.zh: 我们去找老师帮忙吧。

template: How much is/are ...? — It's/They're ... yuan.
grammar_point: how much 疑问句；单复数一致
explanation_zh: 问价用 how much；单数 is，复数 are。

examples.en: How much is this T-shirt? — It's 50 yuan.
examples.zh: 这件 T 恤多少钱？——50 元。

examples.en: How much are these socks? — They're 10 yuan.
examples.zh: 这些袜子多少钱？——10 元。

template: Can I help you? / What can I do for you?
func_zh: 购物时店员主动提供帮助
grammar_point: can 引导的服务用语
explanation_zh: 这是商店/服务场景的固定招呼语；回答常用 I want ... / I'm looking for ...

examples.en: Can I help you? — Yes, please. I want a pair of shoes.
examples.zh: 需要帮忙吗？——是的，我想买双鞋。

examples.en: What can I do for you? — I'm just looking, thanks.
examples.zh: 请问需要什么？——我只是看看，谢谢。

template: When is your birthday? — My birthday is on May 2nd.
grammar_point: when 疑问句；日期前用介词 on
explanation_zh: 具体某一天前用 on；说日期用序数词（2nd, 5th）。

examples.en: When is your birthday? — It's on October first.
examples.zh: 你生日是什么时候？——10 月 1 日。

examples.en: When is the school trip? — On Friday.
examples.zh: 学校郊游在什么时候？——星期五。

template: What's your favorite subject? — My favorite subject is ...
func_zh: 谈论最喜欢的学科/事物
grammar_point: favorite 形容词；what 疑问句
explanation_zh: favorite 本身含“最喜欢”之意，不再加 most。

examples.en: What's your favorite subject? — My favorite subject is English.
examples.zh: 你最喜欢什么科目？——英语。

examples.en: Her favorite sport is swimming.
examples.zh: 她最喜欢的运动是游泳。

template: Why do you like ...? — Because it's fun/interesting.
grammar_point: why 疑问句用 because 回答
explanation_zh: why 和 because 是固定搭档；because 后直接说原因。

examples.en: Why do you like P.E.? — Because it's relaxing.
examples.zh: 你为什么喜欢体育？——因为它让人放松。

examples.en: Why does she like math? — Because it's interesting.
examples.zh: 她为什么喜欢数学？——因为有趣。

template: What time do you ...? — I ... at seven (o'clock).
grammar_point: what time 疑问句；具体钟点前用 at
explanation_zh: 问几点做某事用 what time；钟点前介词用 at。

examples.en: What time do you get up? — I get up at half past six.
examples.zh: 你几点起床？——我六点半起床。

examples.en: What time does school start? — At eight.
examples.zh: 学校几点开始上课？——八点。

template: What time is it? — It's ...
grammar_point: 时间表达：o'clock / half past / a quarter past
explanation_zh: 整点用数字 + o'clock；半点用 half past；一刻用 a quarter past。

examples.en: What time is it? — It's seven o'clock.
examples.zh: 几点了？——七点整。

examples.en: It's a quarter past nine. Let's go.
examples.zh: 九点一刻了，我们走吧。

template: How do you get to school? — I take the bus / walk.
grammar_point: how 疑问句；take + 交通工具
explanation_zh: take the bus/subway 乘公交/地铁；步行用 walk 或 on foot。

examples.en: How do you get to school? — I ride my bike.
examples.zh: 你怎么去上学？——我骑自行车。

examples.en: She takes the subway to work every day.
examples.zh: 她每天乘地铁上班。

template: Don't ... . / Please be ... .
grammar_point: 祈使句的否定：Don't + 动词原形
explanation_zh: 祈使句以动词原形开头；否定直接在前面加 Don't。

examples.en: Don't eat in the classroom, please.
examples.zh: 请不要在教室里吃东西。

examples.en: Be quiet! The baby is sleeping.
examples.zh: 安静！宝宝在睡觉。

template: Can you play ...? — Yes, I can. / No, I can't.
func_zh: 询问能力，会不会做某事
grammar_point: 情态动词 can + 动词原形
explanation_zh: can 后接动词原形，疑问把 can 提前；乐器前加 the，球类不加 the。

examples.en: Can you play the guitar? — Yes, I can.
examples.zh: 你会弹吉他吗？——会。

examples.en: Can he play soccer? — No, he can't.
examples.zh: 他会踢足球吗？——不会。

template: What club do you want to join? — I want to join ...
func_zh: 表达想加入的社团/想做的事
grammar_point: want to + 动词原形
explanation_zh: want 后接 to do；join 表示加入社团、组织。

examples.en: What club do you want to join? — I want to join the art club.
examples.zh: 你想加入什么社团？——美术社。

examples.en: She wants to join the English club.
examples.zh: 她想加入英语社。

template: What are you doing? — I'm watching TV.
func_zh: 描述此刻正在发生的动作
grammar_point: 现在进行时：be + doing
explanation_zh: 说话时正在做的事用现在进行时；动词加 -ing。

examples.en: What are you doing? — I'm doing my homework.
examples.zh: 你在干什么？——我在做作业。

examples.en: Look! They are playing basketball.
examples.zh: 看！他们正在打篮球。

template: How's the weather? — It's sunny/raining.
grammar_point: how 疑问句；形容词/现在分词作表语
explanation_zh: 同义句 What's the weather like?；raining 强调正在下雨。

examples.en: How's the weather today? — It's cloudy.
examples.zh: 今天天气怎么样？——多云。

examples.en: It's raining! Take your umbrella.
examples.zh: 下雨了！带上伞。

template: Is there a ... near here? — Yes, there is.
grammar_point: there be 句型的疑问与就近原则
explanation_zh: there is + 单数/不可数，there are + 复数。

examples.en: Is there a library near here? — Yes, it's on Bridge Street.
examples.zh: 附近有图书馆吗？——有，在大桥街。

examples.en: Are there any pay phones around here? — No, there aren't.
examples.zh: 这附近有公用电话吗？——没有。

template: I'm + 情绪形容词 (happy/tired/excited)
func_zh: 表达自己的情绪和感受
grammar_point: be + 形容词；-ed 形容词描述人的感受
explanation_zh: 主语是人用 -ed（excited 感到兴奋的）；描述事物用 -ing（exciting 令人兴奋的）。

examples.en: I'm so happy today! It's my birthday.
examples.zh: 我今天好开心！今天是我生日。

examples.en: We are excited about the school trip.
examples.zh: 我们对学校郊游感到很兴奋。
